data.acquisitionSummary: Current Telcel Amigo supports physical SIM and online-delivered eSIM. The Aug-2026 prepaid contract says the line lifecycle ends after 365 days without activity and restarts with each Saldo recharge. New Amigo activation still requires the applicable initial package/recharge and mandatory line registration.

keep.action: Make a Saldo recharge before 365 days without activity. The current contract says the lifecycle restarts with each Saldo recharge, and current Telcel material lists prepaid recharges from MXN$10.

data.chinaActivation: Telcel now sells Amigo eSIM online and allows installation over Wi-Fi, but all 2026 mobile lines must be registered before service. The general foreign-user registration page accepts a valid passport but also contains CURP language that makes a passport-only general-Amigo remote path insufficiently clear. Do not substitute the separate Tourist eSIM product for this route.
data.kyc: Mandatory 2026 line registration. Telcel states foreigners may use a valid passport (or temporary CURP for foreigners), and remote registration adds a liveness selfie; the same page also asks for CURP information in all cases, so passport-only completion for ordinary Amigo remains a reviewed ambiguity.
data.payment: Telcel supports online recharge and recharge from abroad; current recharge denominations start at MXN$10. Payment-method/country acceptance can vary by channel.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: Telcel supports SMS while roaming. For U.S./Canada Sin Frontera use, prepaid lines must be active and prior Telcel-network traffic in Mexico is required; the service is not intended for permanent international use. Global inbound OTP reliability is not established by the reviewed evidence.
data.holdReason: The lifecycle economics are attractive, but ordinary Amigo foreign-user remote registration remains ambiguous and route-specific long-term overseas OTP evidence is missing. Keep HOLD rather than conflating it with Telcel Tourist eSIM.
data.tariffSummary: Current contract: 365 days without activity; any Saldo recharge resets lifecycle. Recharges start at MXN$10; mandatory 2026 line registration applies.
guideSteps: Use the ordinary Amigo route only after confirming your 2026 registration path; do not substitute Tourist eSIM evidence.
Recharge Saldo before the 365-day inactivity limit if retaining the number.
Verify the target roaming country and OTP service before relying on long-term use.
